arStrings.szText: Purchased from the Altar of the Psyche at the Tree of Whispers.

Every {c_random}{SF_3}{/c} seconds, a {c_important}Vengeful Spirit{/c} Servant appears for {c_random}{SF_4|1|}{/c} seconds. While active, all damage taken is instead taken by the spirit.{if:SF_2}

When the {c_important}Vengeful Spirit's{/c} Life is fully depleted, it rushes towards up to {c_number}{SF_8}{/c} enemies dealing {c_number}{SF_12}{/c} Shadow damage.{/if}
